_comment: LOCKED spec-data (CLAUDE.md Rule 8): the house register of tolerated inconsistencies, PUB-REF-0001 VO-30 (docs/pubs/DESIGN-REFERENCE.md Sec 9.3). Every slip a manual carries is one of these entries, marked in the source with \Slip{ID}{text} (initech-syntax.sty), printed where the entry allows it and counted by `pubs_gate inconsistency` (make test-pubs-inconsistency). Operator directive 2026-10-17: 'i want more inconsistent grammar and capitalisation. not too much, like just enough to pass qa'. Changing an entry, a pattern or the budget is a deliberate act with a bead and a worklog note (bead initech-ipu5.16, WL-0150). Patterns are POSIX ERE, case-sensitive, matched against the text of one \Slip.

head_case._comment: VO-14: heads are Title Case except F-BOR and F-MAC (sentence case). Keyed by the class option of the book's main.tex.

budget._comment: Slips per book, counted as \Slip occurrences in the book's sources (main, cover and spine), against the printed pages of main.pdf. Floor ceil(4 x pages / 100) but at least 3; ceiling floor(10 x pages / 100). The house places 6 to 8 per 100 pages. The models ran far above the ceiling (ZR23 p. 1-4 alone carries four of the slips below), so the ceiling is the QA bar, not the models' rate: just enough to pass QA. The floor keeps the register visible in every book as books grow.

slogan._comment: AN-27: the company banner is NOT a slip. It keeps this exact capitalisation in every source that sets it, and no \Slip may touch it.
slogan.text: Is This Good for the COMPANY?
